name: Agent2Agent (A2A) Protocol
summary: An open protocol for discovery, capability exchange, messaging, and task-oriented collaboration between independent agentic applications.

interfaces.name: A2A AgentCard
interfaces.description: Machine-readable identity, interfaces, skills, capabilities, and security declarations.

limitations: A2A defines communication semantics and transports; this registry entry does not implement an A2A server or client.
A valid AgentCard does not establish the identity, availability, safety, or trustworthiness of the described agent.
Huffman Protocol's current integration validates local A2A 1.0 AgentCard structure only; it does not fetch cards, verify signatures, or exchange tasks.
